welcome.title: Welcome to Mault
welcome.content: Let's take a quick tour of scanning, collections, and sorting rules. You can skip anytime and restart it later from Settings.

connectCamera.title: Connect a camera
connectCamera.content: Open this menu and choose Camera to connect a webcam (or pair your phone as a camera). It's what captures each card as you scan.

connectDevice.title: Connect your sorter
connectDevice.content: In the same menu, choose Scanner to pair your physical card sorter over USB. Once connected, you can calibrate it or retry the connection here too.

filterStats.title: Filter by clicking stats
filterStats.content: Once you've scanned some cards, this panel totals up value, rarity, color, and set. Click any rarity, color, or set entry to filter the card grid down to just those cards.

exportCollection.title: Export a collection
exportCollection.content: Export your scanned cards to CSV, Manabox, Moxfield, TCGplayer, or Card Kingdom formats from here.

manageCollections.title: Manage your collections
manageCollections.content: Switch between collections here, or click this edit icon anytime to open the full collections manager.

createCollection.title: Create a collection
createCollection.content: Collections keep separate scan histories and sorting rules - one per game, box, or project. Click here to start a new one.

editCollection.title: Edit a collection
editCollection.content: Rename a collection at any time from here.

createSortingRules.title: Create sorting rules
createSortingRules.content: Sorting rules live in named sets, so you can save multiple sorting strategies per collection and switch between them. Click here to create a new set.

editSortingRules.title: Edit sorting rules
editSortingRules.content: Select a bin on the left, then add conditions here (by rarity, color, price, and more) to control which cards land in it. Don't forget to keep one bin marked as the catch-all for anything that doesn't match a rule.

done.title: You're all set!
done.content: That's the tour. You can restart it anytime from Settings > Guided tour.

welcome.title: Sorting logic, in depth
welcome.content: Let's walk through how to build the rules that decide which bin each scanned card lands in. Skip anytime - you can replay this from the same help icon.

sets.title: Rule sets
sets.content: Sorting rules are grouped into named sets, so you can save multiple sorting strategies for a collection and switch between them. Click here to create a new set.

selectBin.title: Select a bin
selectBin.content: Each numbered bin maps to a physical slot on your sorter. Click a bin here to edit the rules that decide what lands in it.

catchAll.title: Set a catch-all
catchAll.content: Exactly one bin should be the catch-all - it receives any card that doesn't match another bin's rules. Toggle it on here.

combinator.title: AND vs OR
combinator.content: Choose whether a card must match ALL of this group's conditions (AND) or ANY of them (OR).

addCondition.title: Add a condition
addCondition.content: A condition matches a field - rarity, color, price, and more - against an operator and a value. Click here to add one.

conditionRow.title: Build the condition
conditionRow.content: Pick the field to match on the left, an operator, then the value(s) to compare against.

addGroup.title: Nest a group
addGroup.content: For more advanced logic, add a nested group with its own AND/OR combinator - useful for rules like "(rarity is mythic OR rare) AND price > $5".

save.title: Save your changes
save.content: Rules aren't applied until you save. Click here once you're happy with this bin's setup.

done.title: That's sorting logic!
done.content: Repeat this for each bin, and don't forget your catch-all. Replay this tour anytime from the help icon on this page.
